statement: This sketch creates a dynamic visual composition of overlapping colored planes intersected by flowing wave formations. The background features deep, saturated colors that shift and move independently across the canvas. Horizontal waves ripple through the scene with varying amplitudes and frequencies, creating an illusion of continuous, restless motion. The color saturation oscillates naturally as the waves interact with the solid planes, producing a mesmerizing interplay between geometric forms and fluid dynamics. The composition evolves organically without any external input, demonstrating how simple mathematical functions can create complex, visually engaging patterns.
